name: Synara
used: The chat transcript (turn layout, tool rows, streaming text, durations, table repair), sign-in checks, the Claude model catalog, settings layout and styles, the empty chat's animated ASCII background.

name: T3 Code
used: Through Synara and Akeru Bot, both built on it; directly: how the Usage page reads Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode and Pi history and prices it, and how the ⌘K palette matches and ranks what you type.

name: Akeru Bot
used: Conversation history and priming, the bot roster, question cards.

name: MonoCode
used: The work view (how a bot's steps are grouped, summed up in a line and folded away in the chat), and how plan limits read their windows and reset times.

name: Silero VAD
used: The voice activity model voice mode ships (silero_vad_v5.onnx).

name: Rare UI
used: Animated components by Swami Malode (https://github.com/swamimalode07/rare-ui), ported into src/renderer/src/components/rare: voice mode's orb (FluidOrb), voice notes (VoiceNote), pictures and files appearing (GridReveal), the time and date wheels (DurationPicker), secret fields on Vault cards (PasswordInput), one-time codes (OTPInput), notices (Toast), reactions (EmojiReaction), the Usage page's activity grid (GitHubActivity) and rolling numbers (AnimatedCounter), code blocks (CodeBlock), the chat's working line (AiStatus), ticks and checkboxes (the task list's check) and the delete button that asks in place (DeleteButton). The app's own controls, cards and motion follow Rare UI's design language since the 2026-11-14 overhaul.

name: Geist
used: The desktop app's typeface, and the plan cards', as appubot.com is set (@fontsource-variable/geist 5.3.0). SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright 2024 The Geist Project Authors.

name: Simple Icons
used: Some agent logos. CC0 1.0: no attribution needed; the logos are their owners' trademarks.

name: Instrument Sans
used: The face of headings in the phone app and on the install screens. SIL Open Font License 1.1.

name: JetBrains Mono
used: The face of code, commands and file names. SIL Open Font License 1.1.

name: Inter
used: Text where the system's own face isn't there. SIL Open Font License 1.1.

name: Hugeicons
used: The icons across both apps (its free set).

name: Agent Client Protocol
used: How AppuBot talks to every agent, and the registry behind More agents.

name: Composio
used: Connect apps: the sign-ins and tools for your apps.

name: Cua
used: Computer use: how a bot sees and works an app's window.

name: sherpa-onnx
used: Hearing and speaking on your own computer.

name: noVNC
used: Showing your AppuBot computer's screen in the app.

name: Electron and Expo
used: What the desktop app and the phone app are built with.
